svg.title: Where the mask and its decoded state live
svg.desc: The encoded edge record and ordinary property data reside in graph memory. Full14's functional path keeps a separate carrier; in-place Scale6 avoids another edge array. Native per-instruction state is bounded by the CPU's in-flight window. Functional runtime accounting includes bounded commit and prefetch queues, a sixteen-word lookahead and D plus three prediction bits per cache line. D=21 and D=32 are shown separately rather than treating the Scale6 cost as universal.
svg.text: Where the mask and its decoded state live
Edge storage, per-instruction association and per-cache-line predictions have different lifetimes.
Graph memory: records are not property values
CSR offsets: row boundaries are unchanged
R[j]: 4-byte encoded edge record replaces the ID read
p[v]: ordinary F32 algorithm data, not an encoded mask
Full14's functional carrier is separate; the in-place Scale6 path avoids a second edge array.
Per-in-flight native access, not per graph edge
I1: captured hint + its translated address
D is the stored semantic-deadline width
DO NOT TURN STATE INTO AN AREA CLAIM
both queues and lookahead enabled in these totals
8 MiB model totals: Full14 3,148,352 bits; Scale6 4,590,584 bits. Baseline cache data/tags remain separate.
Native capture, validation, port logic and planned 128-byte lookahead require their own cost accounting.
These bit counts are not synthesized area, and the 512-bit functional window is not a native buffer implementation.
